adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the code changed from a single `find`ed calendar reference to `filter` + `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. The recurring-series deletion logic (iterating `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and then `for (const updBooking of updatedBookings)` calling `await calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` and `apiDeletes.push(...)`) now runs inside that per-reference loop. If there are multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., multi-host / multi-calendar bookings), the same nested credentials × updatedBookings deletions will be executed once per reference, causing duplicate remote deleteEvent calls and duplicating entries in `apiDeletes`.
